Container.Name: TautWeekly for Plex
Container.ExtraParams: --read-only --tmpfs /tmp:rw,noexec,nosuid,size=256m,mode=1777 --stop-timeout 1800 --security-opt no-new-privileges:true --cap-drop ALL --cap-add CHOWN --cap-add DAC_OVERRIDE --cap-add FOWNER --cap-add SETGID --cap-add SETUID
Container.Overview: Generate preview-first weekly Plex activity newsletters using Tautulli. The WebUI opens the authenticated TautWeekly Manager for setup, verification, previews, test delivery, and embedded scheduling. After installation, retrieve the one-time pairing token from the container Console with: /opt/tautweekly/bin/run-as-user.sh /opt/tautweekly/bin/tautweekly-manager access-bootstrap --data-dir /data/manager. The pairing token is never written to logs. Unraid owns container lifecycle and stable image updates.
Container.Description: TautWeekly for Plex generates activity, welcome, quiet-week, and milestone email newsletters. Configuration, Manager credentials, state, backups, and generated output stay in private appdata. Manager authentication is mandatory and scheduling is disabled by default. Review previews and controlled TestEmail delivery before enabling production sends. No in-container updater, Docker socket, privileged mode, insecure default password, or edge image is enabled.
Container.ExtraSearchTerms: Tautulli Plex newsletter email activity digest
Container.Requires: A reachable Tautulli server, an SMTP STARTTLS account, and a trusted LAN port for the authenticated Manager.
Container.Changes: 2026-08-18: Added capability-aware Manager update status with Unraid-owned Docker/Apps guidance and host-adapter compatibility detection. 2026-08-16: Replaced the read-only preview listener with the authenticated NAS Manager and embedded schedule controls. 2026-08-13: Applied canonical branding and safe PUID/PGID recovery.

Config.Name: Manager Web UI
Config.Description: Authenticated Manager for a trusted LAN. Do not expose plain HTTP publicly; use an explicitly configured TLS reverse proxy when remote access is required.

Config.Name: Appdata
Config.Description: Private configuration, Manager credentials, state, backups, logs, assets, and generated previews. Preserve this path across updates and reinstalls.

Config.Name: Timezone
Config.Description: IANA timezone used by the weekly scheduler, for example America/Phoenix.

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: Non-root Unraid user ID used for appdata ownership.

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Non-root Unraid group ID used for appdata ownership.

Config.Name: UMASK
Config.Description: Restrictive file-creation mask for configuration and output.

Config.Name: Preview Base URL
Config.Description: Optional LAN URL embedded in preview links, for example http://tower:8787. Never use a public URL.

Config.Name: Manager Allowed Hosts
Config.Description: Optional comma-separated DNS hostnames accepted by the Manager, for example tower,tautweekly.example.test. IP-literal access needs no entry. Do not include schemes, paths, ports, or wildcards.

Config.Name: Secure Manager Cookies
Config.Description: Set true only when every browser connection uses HTTPS through a correctly configured TLS reverse proxy. Plain HTTP login cannot work while enabled.

Config.Name: Package Kind
Config.Description: Identifies the Unraid-owned update path to the Manager. Keep this at the value supplied by Community Apps.

Config.Name: Host Adapter API
Config.Description: Package compatibility marker used to detect an older saved Unraid template. Keep this at the value supplied by the current Community Apps template.
